Title: Establishes a learning module to provide education on tickborne illnesses in the state of New York
Summary: Establishes a learning module to provide education on tickborne illnesses in the state of New York for state medical colleges and universities, county departments of health, and the public.
LawCode: Add Art 2 Title 9 §269-a, Pub Health L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to increasing knowledge of tickborne illnesses in the state of New York
